shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; ls -R .agents | head -50
cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; ls src __agent_eval__; cat src/* index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination 2>&1 | head -60
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination 2>&1 | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/Table build/esm/components/Table/hoc build/esm/components/Pagination 2>&1 | head -50; grep -n "Table\|Pagination" build/esm/components/index.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Table/Table.d.ts Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts Pagination/Pagination.d.ts Pagination/types.d.ts Table/index.d.ts Table/hoc/index.d.ts; ls Table/hoc/withTableSelection Table/hoc/withTableSorting

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc && cat withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -150; grep -n "meta\|selectedIds\|getRowId\|id" withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -40
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30 && npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -8
